channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: 5 Seconds of Summer Bring Out The Wiggles in Melbourne
item.description: Melbourne got a surprise singalong! 5 Seconds of Summer brought out The Wiggles—and the crowd went bananas 🎸🟣🟡🟢🔴

item.title: Aerosmith Bring Out Run-DMC, Alice in Chains Members, and More Friends to Rock Night Two at Hollywood Bowl: Review + Setlist
item.description: Aerosmith’s Hollywood Bowl night two turned into an all-star rock party, with Run-DMC, Alice in Chains members, and more joining the fun 🎸🤘

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Announces First-Ever Christmas Song ‘Take Me Home’: Here’s When It Arrives
item.description: Olivia Rodrigo is bringing a little holiday heartbreak 🎄 Her first-ever Christmas song, “Take Me Home,” is on the way! ✨

item.title: My Chemical Romance Land First #1 Album With The Black Parade 20 Years After Its Original Release
item.description: Two decades later, *The Black Parade* marches to its first-ever #1! 🖤 MCR’s iconic album is still making history. 🎺🤘

item.title: Morgan Wallen Unveils Sand In My Boots 2027 Lineup: Kings of Leon, Ella Langley, and More
item.description: Morgan Wallen’s Sand In My Boots 2027 lineup is bringing the heat—Kings of Leon, Ella Langley, and more are headed to the beach! 🌊🎶

item.title: Wu-Tang Clan to Headline Detroit Lions Thanksgiving Game Halftime Show
item.description: Detroit gets a legendary halftime takeover 🐝 Wu-Tang Clan is bringing the beats to the Lions’ Thanksgiving game! 🎤🦁

item.title: My Chemical Romance Top the ‘Billboard’ 200 With 20-Year-Old Album
item.description: Twenty years later, *The Black Parade* is still marching strong 🖤 My Chemical Romance just topped the Billboard 200!

item.title: Gracie Abrams (And David S. Pumpkins) Returns To SNL
item.description: Gracie Abrams is back on the SNL stage—and David S. Pumpkins is along for the ride 🎃🎶 Who’s ready for this duo?

item.title: Billy Strings Plays He-Man-Themed Set Dressed As He-Man
item.description: Masters of the pick! 🎸 Billy Strings went full He-Man for a power-packed, Eternia-inspired set. By the power of the riff! ⚔️

item.title: Harry Styles Wraps Up MSG Residency With Pizza Rat Costume, “Psycho Killer” Cover, Jalen Brunson
item.description: Harry Styles closed out MSG in true NYC style: Pizza Rat, a Talking Heads cover, and Jalen Brunson in the mix 🍕🐀🎶

item.title: Lizzo Recreates Dolly Parton’s Iconic ‘Jolene’ Look for Halloween
item.description: Lizzo brought full Jolene energy this Halloween—and Dolly’s iconic look has never looked so fabulous! 💖🤠

item.title: My Chemical Romance Bring Out Bert McCracken, Confirm Plans For New Album
item.description: The Black Parade gets a guest appearance! 🖤 My Chemical Romance brought out Bert McCracken—and confirmed a new album is in the works. 🤘

item.title: SZA Seemingly Confirms Coachella 2027 Headlining Appearance, Work on New Album
item.description: SZA might be heading to the Coachella main stage—and a new album is in the works? The vibes for 2027 are already immaculate 🌵✨

item.title: Valentín Elizalde’s Legacy Gets a New HBO Max Docuseries & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music
item.description: Valentín Elizalde’s story is getting the docuseries spotlight 🎤 Plus, more feel-good moments celebrating Latin music and the artists who keep its spirit alive ✨
